result.note: Tests India–Nepal power cooperation: the approving ministry, the export quantity and duration, and the use of existing transmission lines.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, India approved electricity exports to Nepal after floods damaged Nepal's hydropower infrastructure. Consider the following statements about this approval:
items: India's Ministry of Power approved exports of up to 654 megawatts for 18 hours a day.
The supplies will flow through newly built cross-border transmission lines.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: The Ministry of Power approved up to 654 MW daily from midnight to 6 pm, between 13 September and 31 December 2026. Statement 2 is wrong because the supplies use two existing cross-border transmission lines, not new ones. The ministry will review volumes for January 2027 in December.
questions.source: On Monday, India’s Ministry of Power approved exports of up to 654 megawatts to Nepal for 18 hours daily, from midnight to 6 pm, between 13 September and 31 December.
